title: Singleton coefficients under transitive symmetry
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $p\in(0,1)$, and let $f:\{ -1,1\}^n\to\{ -1,1\}$ be invariant under some coordinate permutation carrying any specified coordinate to any other. Then for all coordinates $i,j\in\{1,\ldots,n\}$, the biased Fourier coefficients of $f$ on the singletons $\{i\}$ and $\{j\}$ are equal.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
For every pair of coordinates, a permutation carries the first to the second and leaves $f$ invariant under the induced input permutation
